content: अनति {%ind.%} Not very much; compounds beginning with अनति may be analysed by referring to अति; e. g. अनतिक्रमः moderation; अनतिक्रमणीय not to be transgressed, inviolable; अनतिदृश्य opaque; अनतिद्भुत unsurpassed, real, true, proper, ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता <ls>Rv. 8. 90. 3</ls>. अनतिव्याध्य invulnerable; अनत्यन्तगति <ls>P. V. 4. 4</ls> sense of diminutive words; अनत्यय imperishable, undecaying <ab>&c.</ab>; अनतिप्रश्न not to be asked to excess; अनतिविलम्बिता absence of delay; fluency as a speakerʼs qualification, one of the 35 Vāgguṇas, <ab>q. v.</ab>
